context: Evaluates correct usage of calculateLevelMiters and pointToKey from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must call calculateLevelMiters with WallNode arrays to obtain WallMiterData, then correctly read junctionData and junctions maps, and use pointToKey to serialize Point2D values for map lookups.

checklist.name: calculateLevelMiters call
checklist.description: Calls calculateLevelMiters(walls) with an array of WallNode objects and receives a WallMiterData object in return.

checklist.name: junctions map access
checklist.description: Reads WallMiterData.junctions to detect how many junction points were found for a given wall configuration (L, T, or no junction).

checklist.name: junctionData map access
checklist.description: Reads WallMiterData.junctionData keyed by junction string key to retrieve per-wall left/right intersection Point2D values.

checklist.name: pointToKey usage
checklist.description: Uses pointToKey(point) to convert a Point2D into a string key, using it to look up junction entries in the junctions or junctionData map.
